offerings.name: Search
offerings.pricing: Search costs 2 credits per 10 results, rounded up. Entry plan Hobby: $19/month billed monthly, or $16/month billed annually, for 5,000 credits per month (2,500 searches or 5,000 pages scraped).
offerings.free_quota: Free Plan: 1,000 credits / month; 500 searches or 1,000 pages scraped. No cost, no card.
offerings.output_type: 按 web、news、images 分组的结构化结果，含标题、描述和 URL；可选返回全文 Markdown、HTML、链接或截图
offerings.note: 每10条结果2 credits并向上取整；抓取结果另计费。企业端到端ZDR为每10条结果10 credits。
